comment.text: RIT1 M90 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v2. Source observations include Biliary tract tumors; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: biliarytract; Bladder tumors; Hematologic neoplasms; Breast tumors. Additional source tumor types are retained in the structured record. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position.

An observed synonymous or stop allele is retained for source fidelity and is not automatically classified as oncogenic.
